content: {"praised":["Engaging romance blending Bollywood and Hollywood elements.","Spices portrayed as a character, adding magical depth.","Story encourages doing the right thing, moral themes.","Aishwarya Rai and Dylan McDermott chemistry.","Captivating mystical connection between protagonist and spices."],"criticized":["Boring, flat, lacking interesting characters.","No passion, similar to Like Water for Chocolate.","Action confined to one location, dull pacing.","Title character trapped, limited plot development.","Overall story feels unoriginal compared to Chocolat."]}
